scientific_integrity: An exact model-specific analytic theorem derived from a stationary Markov generator, with an independent four-time resolvent check. The reported proof does not establish publication priority or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric independent Poisson changes of angular-velocity sign in an isotropic harmonic trap.
All deterministic parameter classifications require positive confinement, propulsion, rotational diffusion, and switching rates; translational thermal diffusion may be zero.
Does not classify stationary densities, asymmetric switching, nonlinear traps, experimental robustness, or higher cumulants.
title: A universal one-quarter chirality-flip boundary for stationary kurtosis in a trapped swimmer
